name: Dalaran (as approved)
note: Approved in the East Asian hall style; in the game Dalaran is a violet city of mage spires. Kept as approved until the owner says otherwise.

concept.setting: a walled hill town of terraced halls under a clear sky
concept.buildings: timber halls on stepped stone platforms, red columns below and white plaster in dark timber above, deep eaves on brackets, concave violet tile hipped roofs with upturned corners
concept.landmark: a many-eaved violet pagoda over the central square
concept.street_life: paper lanterns on red posts, gate arches over the avenues, courtyard gardens, tea stalls, bell pavilions
concept.greenery: willows, gold ginkgo, flowering cherry, bamboo groves, lily ponds
concept.materials: stripped mangrove, dark oak, calcite, polished andesite, stone bricks, purpur tile
